title: Template bits match tableau instruction bits
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $n$ be a natural number, let $z$ be a finite Boolean string, let $\theta$ be a template, and let $e$ be a register record. Suppose the template operation list equals its instruction-operation list, the input-count and hard-wired-input-length registers of $e$ are $n$ and $|z|$, and an instruction has kind equal to the kind of $\theta$. Assume the template’s source expressions, evaluated at the register record, give exactly the instruction’s source list, whose length is the configuration arity; every such source is valid for the input length $|z|+n$, output width determined by $M$, and instruction index in $e$. Then executing the template produces exactly the encoded bits of the tableau instruction.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols, with $k$ work tapes
$n$ is a natural number and $z$ is a finite Boolean string
the template operation list equals its instruction-operation list
the instruction kind equals the template kind
the template’s evaluated sources equal the instruction source list
the instruction source list length equals the configuration arity
each template source is valid for input length $|z|+n$, the machine-determined output width, and instruction index $e.i$
